plugin_voice_input_description: Hold the voice input hotkey and talk: what you say is typed into the game chat (after the blocklist, polishing or translation if you set them up). She also uses it when she speaks in the chat for you
plugin_voice_input_tool_send: Speak in the game chat for you
plugin_voice_input_off_note: When it's on, hold the voice input hotkey and talk to type into the game chat; she can also speak in the chat for you. Calling her and the wake word keep working while it's off.
